items.title: All-Party mechanism to be formed for post-disaster response
items.summary: Kathmandu, September 16 An all-party mechanism will be formed to address issues arising from the disaster caused by the Bhotekoshi River floods in Rasuwa. An all-party meeting held on Wednesday discussed forming the mechanism within the next seven days. items.title: Bouldin meets Shah, offers US support for Nepal’s disaster recovery
items.summary: The US chargé d’affaires expressed condolences over the Rasuwa floods as the prime minister called for greater global cooperation on climate-related risks.

items.title: Footbridges rise again from flood wreckage
items.summary: Repairs and reconstruction are underway on 53 footbridges damaged by the August 26 flood along the Trishuli corridor, restoring vital links to markets, schools, health services and jobs.

items.title: Weeks after the Nepal flood disaster, families of the missing hold out hope
items.summary: With 5,130 people still missing in Nepal and hundreds unaccounted for in China, families are scouring hospitals, contacting authorities and tracking digital clues for any sign their loved ones survived.
